Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — team is excited to move to a pilot. Before we start the Dedicated environment setup we need to line up our access control items so the security review can proceed:

- SSO / SAML metadata (we'll provide our IdP metadata; want to confirm ACS / EntityID expectations)

Could you send a mutual action plan (MAP) with owners and dates and any templates for the SAML/SCIM artifacts? Attaching our internal security checklist.

Best,
Priya

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Redwood onboarding - next steps for SSO/SCIM/IP ranges

Hi Priya / Alex — following up in the sync today. A few technical details we confirmed and want to document:

- SAML: Redwood SP supports HTTP-POST and HTTP-Redirect bindings. We expect NameID in emailFormat by default but can support persistent if required. Our ACS endpoint for Dedicated will be: https://dedicated.redwood.ai/saml/acs/NL-2026-088 (will be published in final metadata).
- Attributes: we request email, givenName, familyName, groups (SCIM group support required to populate roles). For SCIM provisioning we'll accept externalId, userName, displayName, active.
- SCIM: we only implement PATCH and PUT; bulk provisioning will be via incremental events during the pilot. Group sync is supported for groups < 5k members; for larger groups we'll use dynamic group mapping.
- IP allowlist: attached a CSV with proposed egress ranges and edge IPs for Dedicated. Note: ranges are subject to change during autoscaling; we'll provide a 72-hour notice window for planned changes.

Security callouts:
- Service accounts: we provision a tenant-scoped service account with scoped tokens. Rotation: we can automate 90-day rotation; for immediate compliance we can apply 30-day rotation for the first cycle if needed.
- Audit logs: we will provide a read-only export for the 90-day SOC2 window; longer retention can be negotiated as an add-on.

I'll attach the SP metadata once the Dedicated deployment is instantiated. For the 11/30 SCIM pilot please provide three test accounts: alice.test@newleafbank.com, bob.test@newleafbank.com, carol.test@newleafbank.com.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Identity Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachments: newleaf_saml_metadata.xml (placeholder), ip_allowlist_ranges.csv
From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: Alex Darrow <alex.darrow@newleafbank.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@newleafbank.com>

Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Redwood onboarding - access control MAP & operational notes

Alex / Priya — quick operational notes from our side so your ops/security teams can review:

- Maintenance windows: Dedicated maintenance will target 01:00–03:00 PT on Sundays; emergency updates will be announced with a 24–72 hour lead depending on risk.
- Failover/rollback: Our rollout plan includes automatic fallback to the verified hosted variant if a Dedicated model fails. No customer data is shared across tenants.
- Network: We recommend allowing the current Dedicated egress CIDR plus the edge IPs in the attached ip_allowlist_ranges.csv. Please validate with networking if they need ASN-level rules instead.
- Testing checklist (high level):
  * SAML login success (SP-initiated and IdP-initiated)
  * SCIM create/update/delete reconciliation
  * Group sync and role mapping validation
  * Service account scoped API calls and rotation test
  * Audit log export and sample SOC2 artifact generation

Next steps: once you return the signed pilot addendum (DocuSign link in MAP) we'll schedule the Dedicated env spin-up. I've added a Jira ticket INF-5123 to track the provisioning tasks.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

- We'll return the signed pilot addendum by EOD 11/30.
- IdP metadata: we'll provide SP-initiated and assert NameID as email.
- Test accounts: sending the three test accounts to Neha now.

- Service accounts: 90-day rotation is fine; we'll request a short runbook for rotation steps so our platform team can automate.

Look forward to the pilot.

—Alex
